description: Strategic update-points registry. Lists every canonical surface that audits / rgs runs may invalidate, with the regenerator command (or 'manual' for surfaces that require Claude judgment), tier (0=atomic, must-refresh-every-run; 5=external/optional), trigger conditions, and lane-discipline locks. Consumed by apply-update-points.mjs and the forge-audit + rgs6 postflight passes.

tiers.0: atomic counts and snapshots — refresh on every audit/rgs run
tiers.1: knowledge indexes — refresh when drift detected or asset count changes
tiers.2: doctrine surfaces — flag for Claude manual review on drift
tiers.3: skills/hooks/scripts — flag for surface change, register new wirings
tiers.4: memory surfaces — append-only, audit for staleness

points.name: PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md
points.rationale: Authoritative live counts (engines/dispatchers/actions/hooks). Every audit must read fresh data; SessionStart hook also throttles 24h refresh.

points.name: BUILD_STATE
points.rationale: BUILT/NEEDS_WIRING/NEEDS_BUILDING/NEEDS_FRONTEND snapshot. forge-audit subtracts shipped from gap lists.

points.name: MILESTONE_PROGRESS
points.rationale: Git-grounded shipped vs claimed delta. Drift cases are highest-value gap candidates.

points.name: CLAUDE-BRIEF.md
points.rationale: Continuous-awareness backbone. Brief drift monitor flags >12h re-inject; full regen on >24h.

points.name: PRISM-BUILD-CONTEXT.md
points.rationale: Last 7d commits, peer claims, per-chat handoffs, queued next.

points.name: PRISM-BUILD-VISION.md
points.rationale: Per-component max-value vision, audit-mapped gaps. Auto-injected; rebuild weekly or on vision-spec change.

points.name: ENGINE_DIGEST.md
points.rationale: 1-line per engine; check-before-create gate. Stale digest causes false negatives in duplication guard.

points.name: DISPATCHER_DIGEST.md
points.rationale: Action counts per dispatcher. Used by route-first discipline.

points.name: CODE_SYSTEM_INDEX.json

points.name: PRISM_SHARED_INDEX_SURFACES
